profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, USA. It trades under the ticker NVDA and reported revenue of 215938000000 USD for the period ending 2026-01-25 in its 10-K filing. Its SEC central index key is 0001045810.

Per its own site, NVIDIA offers the Nemotron family of multimodal, open AI models built for agentic reasoning, advanced math, and visual understanding. The company describes Nemotron models as efficient and suited to long-running agents, with transparent training data and support across platforms including NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark. Related offerings named on the site include NVIDIA NIM microservices for inference and deployment, NVIDIA NeMo for custom agentic AI, NVIDIA Blueprints for reference workflows, and tools such as NVIDIA Dynamo and TensorRT-LLM. The site also describes Nemotron Speech models for speech recognition, text-to-speech, and machine translation, and Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and retrieval. NVIDIA publishes model weights, training datasets, and training techniques under the NVIDIA Open Model License, which the company describes as permissive and permitting commercial deployment without crediting NVIDIA. Bryan Catanzaro, VP of applied deep learning research, is quoted on the site. NIM microservices require an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license.

The site states that NVIDIA works with partners across the ecosystem, including model builders and AI-native companies, and cites ServiceNow in connection with visual Q&A accuracy. The company's law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
